semiconductor_relevance: High — Ucome Tech Co., Ltd specializes in precision ceramic components specifically for semiconductor equipment applications.
summary: Ucome Tech Co., Ltd is focused on providing precision ceramic components and advanced ceramic machining solutions tailored for semiconductor equipment.
